snippet.title: Raccoons to Riches - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Raccoons to Riches is coming to Steam!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778620/Raccoons_to_Riches/

Raccoons to Riches is a Roguelike Deckbuilding game about running a fantasy Item Shop and proving yourself as a super shopkeeper!

You're a little Raccoon in the big world, and you've gotta make rent! Assemble your stock of Item and Business Tactic cards! Hustle your way to incredible profits! Build up your Inventory and Customer Base as you turn your humble shop into an incredible shopping destination!

#indiegame #pcgaming #roguelike #deckbuilding #itemshop #raccoon #cardgame
